name: 33480 · Palm Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33480 (Palm Beach) has 301 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33480 (Palm Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33480 (Palm Beach) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
